thread:
sophie: Heads-up — kicking off an admin rotation surge next Tue. Goal: remove stale admin grants, validate KMS bindings, and reduce blindspots. Need owners, runbook, and a safe canary plan. Target: initial scout results by Wed 10AM.

liam: +1. I can run queries at scale. Do we have a canonical filter for 'stale admin' we want to use?

maria: Tie this to recert evidence. Also watch for cross-account KMS grants — many look like admin but are intentional.

ajay: Oncall: will monitor. If we remove a critical admin binding, rollback must be simple and fast. Recommend staging canary then prod.

sophie: Plan sketch: 1) Scout pass: ownerless OR last_modified >90d 2) Cross-check KMS keybindings and recent key usage 3) Notify owners with evidence link 4) Nightly canary prune in staging for 2 weeks 5) Prod prune window with ops oncall present.

sophie: Scout query (SQL-ish example):
```
-- list roles with admin privileges not updated in 90d
SELECT role, last_modified, owners FROM rbac_roles WHERE is_admin=true AND last_modified < now()-interval '90 days';
```

liam: I'll adapt to our RBAC API: `rbacctl list --filter "admin and last_modified<90d" --json > admin_stale.json`

nora: Can we include an automated evidence bundle in the owner notification? i.e., KMS grants snapshot + last 30d usage: `kms-usage --key-id <id> --since 30d` and a link to the `admin_stale.json` artifact.

maria: Add a safety gate: if a role has active CI jobs, scheduled cron or prod traffic in last 7d, don't auto-prune — mark for manual review.

sec-bot: [automated] Runbook scaffold created: https://internal/docs/runbooks/admin-rotation-surge. Please verify permissions: runbook.read required.

ajay: Volunteers: I can own staging canary runs. Liam will run queries and snapshots. Sophie will coordinate owner outreach. Nora will own notification templates. Maria will own compliance checks.

sophie: Checklist for PRs: tag migrations with `deprecate_admin_binding`, include rollback steps (`rbacctl restore --from snapshot.json`), and update audit log retention for affected KMS keys to 1y for evidence. Deadlines: scout results by Wed 10AM, notification template by Wed 3PM.

liam: I'll post `admin_stale.json` in #eng-security after scanning and attach a quick filter: `jq '.[] | select(.owners==null)' admin_stale.json` to highlight ownerless entries.

maria: Also add an automated smoke test to run after any prune: `smoke-prod-healthcheck --service <owner_service>` so oncall gets an immediate alert if something broke.

sophie: Perfect. I'll draft the notification and ping Legal for any compliance notes around KMS key rotation/evidence. Thanks team :thumbsup:
